'''Nancy Kahn Stanton''' is a [[professor emeritus]] of mathematics at [[University of Notre Dame]].<ref name=home>{{cite web|url=http://math.nd.edu/people/faculty/nancy-k-stanton/|location=University of Notre Dame|title=Nancy K. Stanton|accessdate=Mar 11, 2015|archive-date=July 5, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180705093038/http://math.nd.edu/people/faculty/nancy-k-stanton/|url-status=dead}}</ref> She is known for her research in  [[complex analysis]], [[partial differential equations]], and [[differential geometry]].<ref name=news>{{cite news|url=http://news.nd.edu/news/35620-five-notre-dame-faculty-named-fellows-of-the-american-mathematical-society/|newspaper=Notre Dame News|location=[[University of Notre Dame]]|title=Five Notre Dame Faculty Named Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|first=Marissa|last=Gebhard|date=Nov 14, 2012|accessdate=Mar 10, 2015}}</ref>

==Career==
Stanton received her Ph.D. from [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] in 1973 under [[Isadore Singer]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=11489|title=Nancy Kahn Stanton}}</ref> Stanton now works at [[University of Notre Dame]].<ref name=home/>

==Awards and honors==

In 1981, Stanton became a [[Sloan Research Fellow]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/|title=Past Fellows|location=[[Alfred P Sloan Foundation]]|accessdate=Mar 10, 2015|archive-date=November 6, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161106043224/http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2012, Stanton became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref name=AMS>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref><ref name=news/>

==Selected publications==
* Stanton, Nancy K. Infinitesimal CR automorphisms of real hypersurfaces. ''Amer. J. Math.'' 118 (1996), no. 1, 209–233.
* Beals, Richard; Greiner, Peter C.; Stanton, Nancy K. The heat equation on a CR manifold. ''J. Differential Geom.'' 20 (1984), no. 2, 343–387.
* Stanton, Nancy K. Infinitesimal CR automorphisms of rigid hypersurfaces. ''Amer. J. Math.'' 117 (1995), no. 1, 141–167. 
* Pinsky, Mark A.; Stanton, Nancy K.; Trapa, Peter E. Fourier series of radial functions in several variables. ''J. Funct. Anal.'' 116 (1993), no. 1, 111–132.
